claims.supporting_quote: Our data suggest that SCN9A is an essential and non-redundant requirement for nociception in humans
claims.text: In three consanguineous families from northern Pakistan, homozygous nonsense mutations in SCN9A (S459X, I767X and W897X) caused a congenital inability to experience pain, indicating that SCN9A is an essential and non-redundant requirement for nociception in humans.

claims.text: SCN9A encodes the alpha-subunit of the voltage-gated sodium channel Nav1.7, which is strongly expressed in nociceptive neurons.
